# `pyrite` deprecations

Version: `0.9.0`

<!-- Generated by `pyrite-dev cli-deprecations --write`; do not edit by hand. -->

Per [ADR-0002](../../adr/0002-cli-surface-redesign.md), every renamed or retired `pyrite` command or option keeps its old spelling working for a minimum of 2 minor releases, warns on stderr naming the replacement, and is listed here with its removal target. See the [CLI reference](cli-reference.md) for the current command surface; regenerate this table with `pyrite-dev cli-deprecations --write`.

## Commands

No command spelling is currently deprecated. Every spelling the CLI accepts is canonical; anything else exits as an unknown command.

## Options

No option spelling is currently deprecated. Every option the CLI accepts is canonical; anything else exits as a usage error.

## Implicit defaults

A run that leaves one of these unnamed still resolves the fallback, warns on stderr, and must name it explicitly from the removal release.

| Unnamed | Current fallback | Name it explicitly | Deprecated in | Remove in | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| profile detector | implicit Timepix3 scalar acceptance | pyrite profile set NAME --detector reference | 0.9.0 | 0.11.0 | Includes omitted scalar acceptance fields; reference uses ideal response and raw spectra. |
